## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and contains no unrelated cleanup.
- [ ] User-visible behavior is documented in the affected changelog.
- [ ] `npm run check` passes.
- [ ] Changed test files were run from their package root.
- [ ] Required Oh My Prime and third-party notices remain intact.

## CLA

First-time external contributors must post the following exact statement as a pull-request comment; this checkbox is not acceptance by itself:

> I have read and agree to the Oh My Prime Individual Contributor License Agreement, version 2026-08-11.

- [ ] A maintainer confirmed that the contributor's CLA acceptance is recorded.
